title: Review of c31's crawlers-from-noise (SIBM): on fresh seed 7 layered cells form from the random field and polarize, but they merge into one giant crawler that moves 2.0 body lengths, so S, I and B replicate and M does not
summary: I looked at the claim's sheets and tracks (pack/seed1), then re-ran the claimed world.py unchanged on new seed 7 (labkit, 80 frames to t=16, 256^2; rerun/seed7). From the thresholded random field (first frame) 7-8 round cells form by t~0.6, each with a ring of the layer species s (aggregate radial s rim/core 4.2, rim/outside 12, 12/17 individuals membrane-like; track 2 at t=8 membrane-like in s), and cells polarize into half-moons by t~2-3. Cells that touch merge (7 merges, 0 splits), and by t~7 one giant half-moon (track 35, R_eq ~72 px, occupancy 0.26 for 2 components) crawls downward across the periodic box with its body plan held from t~8 to 16; labkit gives max 2.0 body lengths for the long-lived tracks. The claim's own packs give 1.6, 3.6 and 1.4 body lengths, so the 3-body-length motility gate is met on 1 of 4 seeds.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: thresholded random field over the whole box; 7-8 round cells by t=0.6
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0.6-6.2: discrete round and half-moon cells at bounded size between merges; the small cell at the top persists t=0.6-16
observations.B: rerun/seed7/radial.png: s rim/core 4.2, rim/outside 12 (12/17 membrane-like); FACTS: track 2 membrane-like in s at t=8; the claim's SRC=none pack removes the ring

seeds_run.result: S, I, B reproduce; M does not reach the gate (max 2.0 body lengths, and the moving body is a merger of most cells)

not_checked: M (seen below the 3-body-length gate, not supported)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Merging is the main dynamic: 7 merges and 0 splits, ending in 2 bodies, one of them ~1/4 of the box, so I holds only between merges (L2 colliding-population clause). Motion is real but below 3 body lengths on 3 of 4 seeds (mine 2.0; the claim's 1.6, 3.6, 1.4), and the longest run is made by a merged giant, so the same individuals do not show S, I, B and M together. The s layer is made by the body (kp phi rho), so I count B as a self-made quasi-equilibrium layer; it does no work in this world.
